about: Ros's coding in the reflexive thematic analysis demo (working from home), invented. Every participant turn in order, found by its opening words: each extract as said with its codes, and the passage's note, or empty for a turn reviewed and left uncoded. make_demo_rta.py builds the workbook and the progress file from this and the interview CSV beside it.

extracts.text: I'd fight anyone who tried to take it off me.
I take my tea out into the garden and I just stand there.
I'd never seen my own garden in the morning, in twenty years.
Nobody wants anything off me for ten minutes.
codes: The journey as time of my own

extracts.text: Now I start the day as myself.
I'm saving a fortune on the bus, as well, and on sandwiches.

turns.note: The garden does for her what the train did for Kemi: ten minutes owed to nobody.

extracts.text: I'll put a wash on, or nip to the Co-op. And I feel guilty about that.
Even though I've worked through my break, I feel like I've been caught out.
if you weren't at your desk, someone would say, where's Ros?
I'll have the work phone in my apron pocket, like a teenager.
the work phone sits on the worktop next to the bread bin. And it goes off.
codes: No room that is only home

extracts.text: So I've started putting it in the drawer.
Started is when I put my lanyard on.
codes: Small rituals to start and stop

extracts.text: that's Ros from revenues now, not Mum.
codes: Small rituals to start and stop

extracts.text: If I forget to take it off, I'm still sort of at work in my head while I'm doing the tea.
codes: Small rituals to start and stop

extracts.text: I'm the one who takes her to her appointments now.
codes: Care that lands on the one at home

extracts.text: Now it's, well, Ros is at home. As if home means free.
codes: Care that lands on the one at home

extracts.text: It landed because I was the one at home.
codes: Care that lands on the one at home

turns.note: 'As if home means free': the phrase for the whole of this pattern. Check it across the others.

extracts.text: he's got a business, hasn't he. And I've only got a job.
Last Thursday I had six parcels in my hall, and only one of them was mine.
Like being at home and being free are the same thing.
Like I'd let her into my kitchen without asking her.
I put a sign on the door after that.
I don't miss being on show all day.
At home nobody's looking, and I'm a lot more myself.
I'd rather it was me than a taxi.
codes: Care that lands on the one at home

turns.note: Relief from being looked at in the office, beside guilt at being caught out at home. Both are about being watched.

extracts.text: It's women like me, with a mum and a teenager and a bad knee, who'd have packed in work years ago if it wasn't for this.
You keep your head down and you count your blessings.
codes: A perk you can't complain about

turns.note: Her keenness and her silence about its costs come in the same breath.
